board.title: Checkout visual/browser QA
board.goal: Verify the checkout journey through real user interactions.

browser_capability.summary: The current runtime exposes no browser interaction tool.

cards.title: Checkout navigation and validation
cards.summary: Exercise the checkout journey from its initial entry point without deep links.

preconditions: The user-provided application is already running.
steps: Open the initial cart entry point.
Use visible controls to proceed through checkout.
Submit an invalid form and observe validation.
Complete the allowed non-destructive path and verify navigation.
reproduction.expected: Layout, interaction, validation, loading, and navigation remain usable.
reproduction.actual: Not executed because browser capability is unavailable.

acceptance_criteria: Every step is performed through the product UI after the initial entry point.
Browser observations are linked as redacted evidence before completion.

checks.summary: Browser interaction cannot run in the current host.

cards.next_action: Run this board in a host with a verified browser interaction tool.

blocker.required_action: Provide a runtime with verified browser interaction capability.
